items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: we played the first set, Lucky come on and we played a second set... and old Byrd just kept hollering

ctx.x: But, I said, after that we're going to have -- I think we're going to start getting in the books, okay, we played the first set, Lucky come on and we played a second set and Lucky began to bristle up, you know -- we played a first set
and old Byrd just kept hollering, man, when you going to get in the books. Get in the books. Anyway, so after the third set, we started getting in the books.
Lucky I take it had been playing all his best flag wavers and everything.
